This post exists so Playwright can exercise code blocks, copy buttons, and the table of contents against stable content.

## First Section

Introductory prose for the first section.

## Second Section

Java example:

```java
public class Example {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    System.out.println("hello");
  }
}
```

## Third Section

XML example:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>com.example</groupId>
  <artifactId>demo</artifactId>
</dependency>
```
